🎥🎬: My No Good Reason — Scrubs (2007)

At Sacred Heart Hospital, Dr. Perry Cox and Nurse Laverne Roberts find themselves on opposite sides of a heated debate about whether everything in life happens for a reason. While Laverne believes there is a purpose behind every event, Cox argues that sometimes terrible things happen without any explanation, and no amount of faith can make them fair.

Elsewhere, J.D. and Turk struggle to hide their attraction to Carla’s new nanny, while Elliot teams up with the Janitor to help a dying patient find comfort. As the hospital’s usual chaos unfolds, the doctors and staff are reminded that even the smallest decisions can have unexpected consequences.

But everything changes when Laverne is involved in a devastating accident that leaves her fighting for her life. Suddenly, Cox’s arguments become deeply personal, forcing him to confront the possibility that some tragedies have no satisfying answers. In a hospital filled with laughter and heartbreak, this episode delivers one of Scrubs’ most emotional reminders of how fragile life can be.
